cover.coreProposition: 能够改变准入相关行为的转换会产生新的证据主体；部署授权必须绑定祖先身份、精确转换、输出哈希、针对输出的验证与部署目标，血缘只能证明来源，不能自动继承行为授权。
cover.visualMetaphor: A cyan sealed artifact crystal emerges from an amber transformation prism, carrying a bright immutable fingerprint into a precise deployment frame.
cover.semanticObject: A cyan artifact crystal emerging from an amber transformation prism with an immutable fingerprint.
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a single transformed artifact, clear before-and-after depth, strong thumbnail hierarchy and generous negative space
